description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Confido is the AI infrastructure powering modern CPG, serving over 200 brands. They are seeking a Full-Stack Engineer (Early Career) to build new product features and systems, working closely with experienced engineers to develop AI-powered workflows and create intuitive product experiences.
Software engineer for financial document processing, data pipelines, and AI workflows

Responsibilities:
• Build and ship product features across the stack with guidance from the team
• Contribute to backend systems and data pipelines for financial data processing
• Support the development of AI-powered workflows (computer vision + NLP)
• Help design user interfaces that simplify complex financial workflows
• Collaborate with engineering, product, and occasionally customers to iterate on features
• Learn quickly and take on increasing ownership over time
• Helping build systems to extract data from financial documents
• Supporting efforts to scale data ingestion from multiple sources
• Contributing to analytics and forecasting tools for CPG brands
• Improving user experiences that turn complex data into actionable insights

Requirements:
• Internship, academic project, or equivalent hands-on experience in software engineering
• Strong programming fundamentals (any language)
• Interest in backend, full-stack, or AI-driven systems
• Eagerness to learn, take feedback, and grow quickly

Preferred:
• Exposure to backend development, APIs, or data processing
• Familiarity with AI/ML concepts or tools
• Strong communication skills and willingness to collaborate
• Interest in startups and fast-paced, high-ownership environments
• CS degree (or in progress) or equivalent experience
